title: (Updated) 'Add explainer video' Skill in PPT Copilot
summary: The rollout of the "Add explainer video" skill in PowerPoint Copilot is paused. This feature converts static slides into animated explainer videos for Frontier users on desktop, Mac, and web. No admin action or compliance concerns are required. Updates will be shared via Message center.
body:
Updated November 11, 2026: Rollout is currently paused. We will communicate via Message center when we are ready to proceed. We apologize for any inconvenience. 

[What and Why:]

Use the "Add explainer video" skill in Copilot for PowerPoint. This is a built-in skill rolling out as an experimental skill to Frontier users. Available on desktop, Mac, and web.

[Rollout Schedule:]

Frontier/Insider (Worldwide): We will communicate via Message center when we are ready to proceed.

[Impact on Your Organization:]

Ability to convert a static slide into an animated explainer video.

[Action Required/Recommendations:]

No admin action is required.

[Compliance considerations:]

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
